prerequisites: To enroll in specific technology subjects (third year), students must have passed at least 60 ECTS credits from the basic training module and the common industrial branch subjects (first and second year).
Knowledge and mastery of the 2nd-year course Applied Mechanics is absolutely essential.

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and skills for the calculation, design, and testing of machines.
Apply the fundamentals of kinematics and dynamics of mechanisms necessary for professional development.
Solve mechanism problems by qualitatively and quantitatively analyzing the problem, proposing hypotheses and solutions.
Prepare written and oral works and reports adequately explaining the procedures used and interpreting the obtained solutions.
Discuss and make decisions in group work.
Acquire proficiency in solving typical problems of mechanism kinematics, as well as in handling machine dynamics analysis techniques for both rigid and deformable bodies.

syllabus_topics: Topic 1: Basic concepts of mechanisms and machines.
Topic 3: Kinematic analysis of plane mechanisms.

assessment_methods.method: Seminars and Laboratory Practice (Bloque V and report)

assessment_rules: To pass, the weighted average must be 5 or higher, and a minimum grade of 4 must be obtained in each of the 5 blocks. If a grade of 4 is not obtained in any block, the maximum final grade will be 4.5. In case of failure, grades of 5 or higher in individual blocks are retained for the current academic year, allowing students to re-examine only the un-passed blocks. Students can opt for a final evaluation (100% exam) instead of continuous evaluation by notifying the lecturer within the first 9 weeks of the semester. Failure to take the exam in the ordinary or extraordinary call results in "Not presented". Violations of the ethical code result in a grade of 0.0 for the entire course.
